remarks: Welcome to this spacious and charming home located in Canoga Estates, a desirable 55+ community in the heart of Canoga Park! This well-maintained residence offers 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms with a comfortable and functional floor plan designed for everyday living and entertaining. The bright and inviting interior features a spacious living room, dining area with updated white cabinetry, central air conditioning and heating, and plenty of natural light throughout. The kitchen offers ample cabinetry, a convenient breakfast bar, pantry, refrigerator, microwave, stove, and a skylight that fills the space with natural light.
